collection.title: Volvo V60 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Volvo V60 from Mid 2018 onwards is fitted with a new type of wiper blade called the 'AquaBlade'. This unique type of wiper, developed by Valeo, delivers wiper fluid directly onto the windscreen through the wiper blade. The drivers side requires a 24" AquaBlade and a 20" for the passengers side. They are available in both heated and unheated varients but these are not inter-changeable, so replacment must be the same version as originally fitted to your V60. THE VA311 IS A SPECIAL ORDER PART - PLEASE ALLOW AN EXTRA 2-3 WORKING DAYS.
